# scikit-learn

> scikit-learn is a Python machine learning library providing tools for supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation, and data preprocessing.

scikit-learn offers comprehensive APIs for regression, classification, preprocessing, and metrics evaluation. It integrates with SciPy, NumPy, and joblib to provide efficient, production-ready machine learning algorithms and utilities.

## Key Topics

- Linear Regression
- Classification Metrics
- Model Evaluation
- Label Encoding
- Preprocessing
- Mean Absolute Error
- Mean Squared Error
- Loss Functions
- Supervised Learning
- Ordinary Least Squares
- sklearn.metrics
- sklearn.preprocessing
- Regression Models
- joblib
- SciPy

## Regression Models & Evaluation

- [LinearRegression](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.linear_model.LinearRegression.html): LinearRegression API reference with parameters, methods, and OLS implementation
- [mean_absolute_error](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.metrics.mean_absolute_error.html): mean_absolute_error metric API reference for regression model evaluation
- [mean_squared_error](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.metrics.mean_squared_error.html): mean_squared_error metric API reference for regression model evaluation

## Classification Metrics & Evaluation

- [classification_report](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.metrics.classification_report.html): classification_report API reference with precision, recall, and F1 metrics
- [log_loss](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.metrics.log_loss.html): log_loss API reference for classification probability and cross-entropy loss

## Data Preprocessing & Encoding

- [LabelEncoder](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.preprocessing.LabelEncoder.html): LabelEncoder API reference for categorical data encoding and transformation
